title: When the Autopsy Wakes Revisited
author: P. M. Zhou
blurb: Jude Vasquez, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
